name: change2md-local
description: Convert supplied files and URLs to Markdown on your own computer.

interface.longDescription: Change2MD Local converts explicitly supplied files and URLs to Markdown on the user's own computer through Microsoft's official MarkItDown MCP server. It requires uv and a desktop MCP client with local STDIO support. It is not available in ChatGPT web or mobile.
interface.defaultPrompt: Convert this supplied file to Markdown locally.
